 Monica Barbaro’s Plunging Brandon Maxwell Dress Dips Dangerously Low at GQ MOTY
 November 12, 2026 
 By
 Viha Shah 
 Monica Barbaro made quite the impression at the 2026 GQ Men of the Year party, stepping onto the red carpet in a head-turning ensemble. The actress embraced a daring yet sophisticated approach to evening wear, choosing a look that balanced elegance with a bold silhouette. With its striking design and unexpected details, her outfit was easily one of the night’s standout fashion moments.
 Monica Barbaro goes low in ultra-plunging Brandon Maxwell dress at GQ Men of the Year
 Monica Barbaro at the 2026 GQ Men Of The Year. pic.twitter.com/tBkopQr7I1 
— 21 (@21metgala) November 13, 2026 
 For the star-studded event, Monica Barbaro wore a plunging dress from Brandon Maxwell’s Spring/Summer 2027 ready-to-wear collection. The black-and-white creation featured a dramatically low neckline that extended well below her chest, creating a daring V-shaped opening that nearly reached her waist.
 The sleeveless black bodice hugged Barbaro’s figure, with its wide shoulder straps framing the ultra-plunging neckline. The fitted design also featured subtle cutouts along the sides, adding another revealing element to the polished look. 
 Meanwhile, the lower half of the dress introduced an entirely different texture and silhouette. Two pointed sections of the black bodice extended toward the hips, giving way to a voluminous white pleated skirt. The fabric fell in soft, flowing folds that ended just below her knees.
 Barbaro completed her outfit with black Aquazzura V Plexi PVC and leather slingback sandals. The pointed-toe heels complemented the darker upper half of her dress without distracting from its distinctive silhouette. For jewelry, the actress opted for sparkling Leviev diamond earrings and an Arielle Ratner Diamond Bomba Ring. The understated accessories allowed the dramatic neckline to remain the focal point of her appearance.
 Her brunette hair was styled in glossy, side-parted waves that cascaded over one shoulder. She kept her makeup soft and radiant, choosing rosy cheeks, subtly defined eyes, and a nude-pink lip. Styled by Elizabeth Saltzman, the Monica Barbaro GQ Men of the Year appearance demonstrated how a classic black-and-white combination can feel anything but ordinary.
